inbox_review: Reviewed the 253 project inbox leads and three scored selections. The scored selections are model price listings without release dates, so none is editorial approval.
archive_review: Compared against the published November 20 GPT-6.2 Astra Work workbook episode and October 2 looping-model architecture episode. No November 24 episode or receipt is present.

openai.reason: November 23 Chat tab rollout of GPT-6.2 Sol is distinct from the November 20 Work/Astra workbook episode, but the improvement is provider-reported and needs a task-specific editorial angle.

anthropic.reason: The latest listed November 20 IPO item does not change a Claude task; the November 9 Fable/Mythos model post is outside the seven-day window.

google.reason: November 17 Tasks calling is useful but geographically limited; November 20 Duplex article documents the mechanism and is a possible builder explainer.

repositories.reason: November 21 Transformers release adds Inkling 2 Mini and other models, but a builder episode needs README, license and setup verification first.

architectures.reason: Google describes the Duplex-to-Gemini system evolution; Transformers describes Inkling 2 Mini's looping decoder. Neither is inferred from closed-model behavior.

candidates.title: GPT-6.2 reaches the ChatGPT chat tab
candidates.summary: OpenAI says a chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol is rolling out globally to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise, with claimed improvements on complex instructions, image questions and web research.
candidates.availability: Rolling out; Enterprise depends on admin settings; Chat tab only, not Work or Codex.
candidates.practical_use: Compare two travel choices from a fixed list of criteria and ask the chat to show which claims need source checks.

source_review.excerpt: This update applies to the Chat experience in ChatGPT.
source_review.availability: Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise rollout; admin-dependent for Enterprise.

candidates.title: Gemini Tasks can call US businesses
candidates.summary: Google says Tasks can propose a call plan, call businesses and return a summary and transcript; users review the plan before dialing.
candidates.availability: English; US users aged 18+ with eligible personal accounts; geographic limits require reconfirmation.
candidates.practical_use: Ask for local service quotes and approve the call plan before any calls.

source_review.excerpt: You can review, approve the call plan before Gemini dials
source_review.decision: defer because the event is seven days old and access is narrow

candidates.title: Transformers 5.24 adds Inkling 2 Mini
candidates.summary: The release documents a smaller multimodal model with a looped decoder; code and setup remain to be checked before production.
candidates.availability: Transformers v5.24.0; model artifact and runtime requirements need verification.
candidates.practical_use: Evaluate a variable-loop quality/speed tradeoff in a documented builder test.

source_review.excerpt: Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality.
source_review.decision: defer pending README, license and executable setup review

editorial_decisions: GPT-6.2 Chat tab was approved and queued as a documented everyday episode for 13:30 Europe/Rome. The distinct audience and product surface are explicit; no measured improvement is claimed by this project. Gemini Tasks calling and Transformers 5.24 remain deferred for the next research review.
